Body.Content:
Applies to: Point of Sale (Store Commerce)

Setup: Store admin configures the control in the Commerce headquarters screen layout designer.

You can add a new Quick Operations control to the transaction screen layout in the headquarters screen layout designer.

Display a configurable set of operations in a purpose-built experience instead of a generic button grid. For example, include manual discount amount, manual discount percentage, transaction comments, and customer purchase order numbers.

Configure operations per screen layout. The control respects POS permissions and hides or disables actions based on user access. Operations use the same workflows as the button grid.

Configure control attributes in the screen layout designer to include custom fields and operations. This capability lets merchants surface extension fields alongside built-in operations.

Provide a graceful empty state when no operations are configured.

GA date: December CY2026

Preview date: July CY2026
